svg.title: Mechanical engineer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as mechanical engineer, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A shaft passes through two bearing races beneath a downward radial-load arrow. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a softly squared face and round glasses.
